headline: GOLIATH SUREBET EXPANDS IN ALL DIRECTIONS: 8.09 g/t AuEq OVER 16m — Bonanza Zone Grows 540m SW + 100m N; Visible Gold In 20 Of 35 Holes, 7 Rigs Running (TSX-V: GOT)
snippet: Goliath Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: GOT) reported August 6, 2026 that assay results from the first 35 holes of its 2026 program at the Surebet Discovery in BC's Golden Triangle are confirming broad gold mineralization across the Bonanza and Golden Gate Zones. Highlight hole GD-26-417 expands the Bonanza and Golden Gate zones 540 metres to the southwest, while GD-26-418 extends the Bonanza Zone 100 metres to the north — both remaining open. Up to 8.09 g/t AuEq over 16.00 metres leads the current assay package, and visible gold to the naked eye has been intersected in 20 of the 35 holes completed (19,931 metres of the 50,000-metre program drilled to date). Seven drill rigs are advancing the program across all Surebet targets, with 63 of the 98 planned holes still ahead in the season.

headline: METALSOURCE LAUNCHES EXPANSION DRILL NEXT TO 16,604 g/t AgEq HOLE — Second Rig Targets District-Scale IP Anomalies; Silver Hill NC MRE Set For Early 2027 (CSE: MSM)
snippet: Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE: MSM) announced August 6, 2026 that it is launching an expansion drill program directly targeting the strike and down-plunge extensions of hole SH26-07 — which returned 16,604 g/t silver equivalent over 2.74 metres, including 209.1 g/t gold — the highest-grade intercept at the Silver Hill polymetallic project in North Carolina. A second drill rig will simultaneously test district-scale targets generated by the company's recent IP geophysical survey, effectively tripling total drilling capacity. The dual-track program is the largest exploration acceleration in Silver Hill's history and is designed to systematically expand known mineralization while advancing the project toward an inaugural NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate targeted for early 2027. For retail investors, Silver Hill's extreme high-grade core combined with the new bulk-target IP coverage makes this a project with both potential for a headline MRE and upside from a wider discovery on surrounding ground.

headline: CODELCO HALTS ANDES NORTE AT WORLD'S LARGEST UNDERGROUND COPPER MINE — 3,000 Workers Idled Over Seismic Risk; Union Warns Up To 2-Year Delay At El Teniente
snippet: Codelco announced August 4, 2026 that it is suspending all development and construction at the Andes Norte project within its flagship El Teniente mine in central Chile after six months of technical analysis identified an emerging deep seismic phenomenon that the company describes as different in character from previously managed risks at the operation. The suspension affects approximately 3,000 workers across four contractor companies covering more than 20 contracts, and carries no defined restart date. A union leader warned the delay could extend up to two years. Andes Norte is one of El Teniente's core structural expansion projects — without it, Codelco's long-term output from the world's largest underground copper mine faces a material step-down. For junior copper developers, the news validates the structural supply deficit thesis at a moment when COMEX copper prices are already at or near all-time highs: another production setback at a flagship operation makes new mine development at any jurisdiction more critical, and NAV models priced at pre-record copper levels continue to look conservative.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD EXPANDS SUNDAY CREEK TO 4.6 MOZ AuEq EXPLORATION TARGET — 5 Prospects Over 1,500m Strike; 9 Rigs Drilling Victoria Gold-Antimony System (TSX: SXGC)
snippet: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd. (TSX: SXGC, ASX: SX2) published an updated exploration target for the Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project in Victoria, Australia on August 4, 2026, now totalling 10.4–11.9 million tonnes at 8.9–12.1 g/t gold equivalent for 3.0–4.6 million ounces AuEq — up from three prospects and 1,020 metres of strike in the prior target to five prospects spanning more than 1,500 metres of strike. New prospect Christina was added to the calculation for the first time, while Golden Dyke and Apollo East expanded materially. Nine diamond rigs are actively drilling to extend the resource definition ahead of a planned maiden mineral resource estimate, with 130.6 kilometres of drilling already reported and 35 kilometres of core still in the assay lab pipeline. The antimony credit makes Sunday Creek particularly timely: China's export restrictions on antimony in late 2025 drove a structural repricing of the metal, and a project delivering both economic-grade gold and a strategic critical mineral from a Tier 1 Australian jurisdiction commands a premium to pure gold peers at current market conditions.

headline: OROCO DRILLS 26.48m AT 1.18% CuEq IN SOUTH ZONE — Phase 2 Extends Santo Tomás Copper Westward Into New Ground; 3 Rigs On Site, Mexico (TSX-V: OCO)
snippet: Oroco Resource Corp. (TSX-V: OCO) reported August 6, 2026 the third set of assay results from its Phase 2 resource drilling program at the South Zone of the Santo Tomás copper project in Choix, Sinaloa, Mexico, with holes S031 and S034 confirming the westward extension of mineralization beyond the current inferred block model limits. The headline interval of 26.48 metres at 1.18% CuEq documents near-surface copper with total and soluble assays indicating oxide-amenable material extending the zone westward; outcrop mapping suggests mineralization may continue a further 330 metres in that direction. Three rigs remain on site advancing Phase 2. At COMEX copper near $6.71/lb, Santo Tomás sits in a commodity environment where bulk-tonnage open-pittable copper porphyry projects with straightforward metallurgy and low strip ratios command serious acquisition attention — and Oroco's systematic block model expansion is the kind of steady derisking that builds that case quarter by quarter.

headline: NV GOLD LAUNCHES 5,000m RC PROGRAM AT SLUMBER — 20-30 Holes Target Shallow Gold In Nevada's Sleeper District; 1,500-Acre Lease Closes (TSX-V: NVX)
snippet: NV Gold Corporation (TSX-V: NVX) announced August 6, 2026 the initiation of a 5,000-metre reverse circulation drill program at its 100%-owned Slumber Gold Project in Humboldt County, Nevada — located approximately 35 kilometres west of the historic Sleeper gold deposit, which produced over 3 million ounces for Amax Gold before closing in the 1990s. Premier Drilling of Elko, Nevada has been contracted for 20-30 holes ranging 175-375 metres depth, targeting new areas of gold mineralization based on prior drilling, surface sampling, and mapping. NV Gold simultaneously announced the closing of a 1,500-acre fee-land lease adjacent to its existing Slumber mining claims, significantly expanding the project footprint. Drilling is expected to commence in early September and run 6-8 weeks. Nevada's established permitting framework and infrastructure make even early-stage RC programs here faster to execute than comparable programs in British Columbia or Yukon, and any meaningful gold intersection in this district would draw immediate attention given the Sleeper district's 30-year production heritage.

headline: SPROTT MONEY: 'NO DOG DAYS IN 2026' — Yen Carry Unwind + Iran + NFP Make August A Volatility Minefield For Gold And Silver
snippet: Sprott Money's August 2026 precious metals market outlook argues that the typical summer 'dog days' quiet period for gold and silver is nowhere in sight this year, as three simultaneous macro wildcards create an unusually high-volatility environment: the Bank of Japan-US Treasury coordination signal on the yen — which risks unwinding the global yen carry trade that has provided market liquidity for decades — the ongoing US-Iran war's persistent upward pressure on energy prices and inflation expectations, and an unusually dense economic data calendar (ADP, JOLTS, NFP) that could reprice Fed rate expectations in either direction within a single week. The piece notes that the July ADP miss and strong gold performance heading into NFP week suggest the precious metals bull trend has reestablished itself above key technical levels, but warns that a single hot employment print could rapidly reverse the week's gains as it did in May 2026 when gold sold off 3% on a 172K payrolls surprise. For retail investors, the key takeaway is that August is a month to hold positions but manage position sizing — the return is there on the long side, but so is the intraday whipsaw risk.

headline: GOLD AT $4,285 FACES MAKE-OR-BREAK JOBS REPORT FRIDAY — NFP Preview: Sub-80K Print Confirms Rate Pivot, 90K+ Reprices The Whole Rally
snippet: With gold at its highest level since mid-June and silver printing a seven-week high at $62.20, FX Empire's August 2026 NFP preview sets out the binary outcome for precious metals heading into Friday's July employment release. The bull case: a sub-80K non-farm payrolls print (consensus 110K) would confirm that the ADP 44K miss reflects genuine labor market softening, implying the Fed's current rate path is already too restrictive and cementing a rate hold or cut at the September meeting — the scenario that sent gold from $4,107 on July 31 to $4,278 by August 5. The bear case: a 90K+ surprise, consistent with the May 172K shock that knocked 3% off gold in a single session, would reprice the September FOMC meeting back toward an additional hike and likely unwind most of the week's gains. Key technical levels: $4,334 is the first resistance gold needs to clear for bulls, with $4,350 as confirmation of a durable structural break; support at $4,200 is the level the bears need to recapture to declare the Hormuz-ADP rally a false start. Silver's $60 floor, established as a major structural level over the summer, should hold on all but the most hawkish prints.
